newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares up on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares up on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: Bank shares rose on increased turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Wednesday as Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce rose to $13.5 from $13.375 and Banque Audi shares reached $18.5 from $18.375.
Turnover in BLC rose sharply to 10,000 shares from 1,000 shares and 15,820 Audi shares changed hands against Tuesday's 12,897.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.31 percent to 115.99.
Solidere shares were steady. A shares traded at $10.25 and B shares were unchanged at $10.75. A total of 194,976 Solidere shares were traded against Tuesday's 245,729.
Total BSE turnover was 220,796 shares for a value of $2,446,612 against 345,626 shares for a value of $2,917,123.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Blancs, Ciments Libanais Eternit and Uniceramic.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.03 percent to 897.83 and the LISPI rose 0.16 percent to 82.76.
